verdict.rationale: LlamaParse is a document-processing platform, so background automations such as scheduled or triggered pipelines are a fair axis for it. However, the evidence shows no first-party way to set up recurring or triggered automations that run on their own. Webhooks only notify you when a one-off job finishes, chaining APIs and batch processing are developer building blocks, and the n8n node puts the automation in a third-party tool.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
